usedFor: Groove holds support tickets and Calendly makes booking links, so “Create Scheduling Link” can follow a “Ticket Opened”.

bestTemplate.name: “Ticket Opened” in Groove, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: Opening a ticket is the moment a call may help, and the booking link is created then.

watchOut: “Ticket Started” and “Ticket Opened” are separate triggers, so pick one or a ticket may get two links.
